mapper.sql:
SELECT A.RECORD_NO, A.CARD_NO, NVL(A.EMPLOYEE_NAME, B.LOCAL_NAME) AS LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(B.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPTNAME, GET_CODE_NAME(B.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.R_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS R_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.R_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS R_TIME, A.DOOR_TYPE, A.REMARK, A.INSERT_BY FROM AR_MAC_RECORDS_COMPANY A LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE B ON A.CARD_NO = B.EMPID WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(A.CARD_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(NVL(A.EMPLOYEE_NAME, B.LOCAL_NAME))) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPTNO = B.DEPTNO START WITH INSTR(',' || #{deptNos, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',', ',' || D.DEPTNO || ',') > 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
AND A.R_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND A.R_TIME < TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
mapper.select: ORDER BY A.R_TIME DESC, B.DEPTNO, B.EMPID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AR_MAC_RECORDS_COMPANY ( RECORD_NO, CARD_NO, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DOOR_TYPE, R_TIME, INSERT_BY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, AR_DATE_STR, DEVICENAME ) SELECT AR_MAC_RECORDS_COMPANY_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{cardNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{employeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{doorType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{swipeDatetime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'M', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SUBSTR(#{swipeDatetime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 10), #{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AR_MAC_RECORDS_COMPANY X WHERE X.CARD_NO = #{cardNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND X.R_TIME = TO_DATE(#{swipeDatetime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
